ModMetaData.name: Phinix Plugin Store — Local Preview
ModMetaData.author: Phinix contributors
ModMetaData.description: Development preview: browse a local JSON index and inspect a locked dependency plan in the Phinix Store tab or mod settings. Extension management is available from the store and host settings; extension toggles take effect after restarting the game. Downloading, installation and Steam actions are not available. Requires the updated Phinix host and ClientExtensionAbstractions 1.3.0.
